why: browser automation, large npm workspace; async-heavy: a CDP Connection, sessions and event emitters behind an abstract api layer with cdp and bidi implementations, npm
library, medium; the GraphQL reference implementation: a lexer and parser, visitor-driven validation rules and an executor; no runtime dependencies, so nothing to install
bundler/CLI, large; a module graph, an AST of node classes for tree-shaking, chunks, and plugin hooks run by a driver, npm
SQL query builder, medium; generic-heavy immutable builders over an operation-node tree, a compiler and dialect drivers; no runtime dependencies, so nothing to install

text editor framework, large pnpm workspace; an editor state of nodes updated in closures ($-functions) and reconciled to the DOM; the boards' packages need only each other, reached through tsconfig paths, so nothing to install
web framework and async networking, medium; partly typed, callbacks and coroutines on an IOLoop over asyncio, its own HTTP/1 implementation; no dependencies
SQL parser and transpiler, large; typed, a tokenizer and a parser per dialect, expression classes and generators, an optimizer of rule functions
graph algorithms library, large; the untyped one: dict-of-dicts graphs, views, and algorithms dispatched to backends by a decorator
ORM and SQL toolkit, very large; typed, a unit of work, mappers and sessions over a Core of compilers, engines and dialects
CLI, small; typed, commands, a store of cloned hook repositories and one module per hook language
terminal emulator, medium workspace; an event loop over a pty, a vte parser driving a Term's grid, and a winit/OpenGL front end
CLI, large single crate; ~100 prompt modules sharing one Context, a format-string parser and per-module configs built by a derive macro
library, medium; image buffers generic over pixel types, a DynamicImage enum, decoder and encoder traits implemented per codec; default formats on

embedded database, small-to-medium; copy-on-write B-trees over a page allocator, read and write transactions; pins its own toolchain (rust-toolchain 1.90), which rustup installs on first use and which needs the rust-analyzer component added
